decks.notes: This deck focuses on playing cheap artifacts creatures and using cards like All That Glitters and Thoughtcast to quickly buff them up and draw more cards. With a low mana curve and plenty of artifact synergies, it aims to swarm the opponent with aggressive creatures while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of Metallic Rebuke adds some disruption to the deck, allowing for some interaction with the opponent's plays. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy fueled by affinity for artifacts.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a aggressive playstyle using cheap, efficient red creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes cards like Goblin Bushwhacker and Kuldotha Rebirth to go wide with tokens, while also packing a suite of direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to close out the game quickly. The goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent while efficiently using resources to deal damage and control the board.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice effects and removal spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Avenging Hunter, Crypt Rats, and Deadly Dispute, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind them out. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Defile and Cast Down to deal with threats efficiently. The Golgari / Jund color combination allows for versatile removal options and strong recursion potential. Overall, the deck excels at generating card advantage and disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using removal spells like Cast Down and Defile, along with creatures like Avenging Hunter and Crypt Rats to maintain board presence. The mana base includes Golgari lands like Bojuka Bog and Khalni Garden for added value. The deck also features cards like Deadly Dispute and Fanatical Offering for value and card advantage. Overall, the Golgari Garden control deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating value and maintaining control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to power up creatures and create a fast, aggressive strategy. By playing a variety of low-cost artifacts like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute, the deck can quickly build a board presence while using cards like All That Glitters and Moon-Circuit Hacker to pump up those creatures. The inclusion of card draw spells like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind helps maintain card advantage. With efficient creatures like Myr Enforcer and Thraben Inspector, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a synergistic mix of creatures and artifacts.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying artifact creatures and using artifacts to buff them, creating a fast and aggressive board presence. By utilizing cards like Myr Enforcer and Gingerbrute alongside synergistic cards like All That Glitters and Moon-Circuit Hacker, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats. With card draw options like Thoughtcast and Thraben Inspector, the deck ensures a steady flow of resources to maintain pressure. Additionally, Metallic Rebuke provides some disruption to control opponents, allowing the deck to push through for a victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with artifact creatures and use cards such as "All That Glitters" and "Of One Mind" to boost their power and draw additional cards. By utilizing cards like "Metallic Rebuke" for disruption, along with efficient mana sources like "Ancient Den" and "Springleaf Drum," this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like "Moon-Circuit Hacker" and "Razortide Bridge" further enhances the deck's synergy and allows for explosive turns.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using removal spells and board wipes to keep the opponent's threats in check. It also utilizes sacrifice effects and token generation to outvalue the opponent and grind them down over time. The deck includes recursion effects to bring back key pieces and card draw to maintain resources. The Golgari / Jund color combination allows for a versatile and flexible control strategy that can adapt to different matchups. The deck aims to establish board presence and dictate the pace of the game through attrition and incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on generating value through sacrificing creatures and artifacts, controlling the board with removal spells like Cast Down and Defile. It also includes cards like Deadly Dispute to exchange resources and gain card advantage. The deck aims to control the game through cards that benefit from sacrificing creatures like Avenging Hunter and Crypt Rats, while utilizing cards like Thorn of the Black Rose and Troll of Khazad-dûm for card advantage and board presence. The deck has a strong control game plan with a focus on out-valuing the opponent through resource management and removal.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts to power up creatures, allowing for aggressive plays and quick damage output. By utilizing cheap artifacts and efficient spells, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early board presence and efficiently utilize resources to maintain pressure throughout the game. Using a combination of card draw and low-cost creatures, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure and force opponents to react quickly in order to keep up with its aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on using cheap artifacts and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a high-powered board presence. By utilizing cards like Ornithopter and Myr Enforcer, along with support from Moon-Circuit Hacker and All That Glitters, the deck aims to swing in for heavy damage early in the game. The inclusion of card draw spells like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind helps to keep up the pressure and maintain card advantage. Metallic Rebuke offers disruption for the opponent's game plan, allowing the aggro strategy to push through for victory.

The main concept of the Boros Aggro deck is to assemble a fast and aggressive board presence using low-cost creatures like Experimental Synthesizer, Kor Skyfisher, and Glint Hawk, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Blast and Lightning Bolt. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and direct damage, while also disrupting graveyard strategies with cards like Relic of Progenitus. The deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent from the early turns of the game and close out the match quickly.

The deck focuses on using artifact creatures and equipment to quickly build a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive attacks. By combining low-cost artifacts like Ornithopter and Gingerbrute with enchantments like All That Glitters, the deck can create large threats early in the game. Metallic Rebuke and Thoughtcast provide disruption and card draw to keep the pressure on. Moon-Circuit Hacker and Myr Enforcer offer additional threats that can quickly close out the game. Overall, the deck aims to win through efficient aggro strategies using an affinity for artifacts.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using Gates to enhance mana production and a variety of spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes creatures like Sacred Cat, Squadron Hawk, and Guardian of the Guildpact for defense and offense. The inclusion of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects helps to maintain control over the battlefield. The deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents by utilizing the flexibility and power of Gates in combination with a strong control strategy.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to efficiently control the board through countering spells, removal, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Counterspell, Snuff Out, and Spell Pierce, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while building card advantage through Deep Analysis and Thought Scour. The deck also includes powerful threats like Gurmag Angler to close out the game. The inclusion of Contaminated Aquifer and Tolarian Terror provide additional utility and flexibility in handling different situations. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and maintain control throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying cheap artifacts and boosting them with enchantments like All That Glitters to create a powerful board presence. Using cards like Thoughtcast and Of One Mind, the deck can draw additional cards to maintain momentum. Moon-Circuit Hacker provides a consistent way to pump up creatures and Metallic Rebuke serves as a disruptive counter spell. The use of artifact lands like Seat of the Synod and Ancient Den helps to reduce mana costs and enable explosive starts.
